b3_scr_statistics.reference_rng_source: std::chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count() in release initialize_rng; verify pinned executable disassembly calls system_clock::now
b3_scr_statistics.reference_job_launch_policy: Launch each reference job as an independent process; serialize job starts and require distinct recorded UTC start seconds as conservative isolation evidence. Sampling jobs may run concurrently after launch. UTC/PID do not observe or establish GPUMD internal RNG seeds.
b3_scr_statistics.burn_in: Discard first 10% of each single full-budget chain once for its one final look; there are no interim or prefix looks in this independent confirmation.

statistics.temperature_mean: Candidate-vs-GPUMD mean difference must be within 2% of 300 K; compare with the registered CI. Also report each engine's absolute offset from 300 K separately. Canonical K variance oracle is Var(K)=3N*(kB*T)^2/2 for 3N unconstrained momentum degrees of freedom. Temperature is reported using product's 3N definition; do not invent an instantaneous target-temperature variance.
statistics.pressure_mean: Candidate-vs-GPUMD mean difference CI must lie within +/-0.1 GPa using independent-seed estimates; also report each engine's offset from Ptarget separately.
statistics.volume_mean: Candidate-vs-GPUMD mean difference CI must lie within +/-0.25% of the GPUMD reference mean; report each engine's mean and absolute target-theory diagnostics separately.
statistics.variance: For T, P and V compare candidate/reference variance ratios; allowed interval [0.85,1.15].
statistics.distribution: For T, P, V report empirical CDF sup-distance and 5th/50th/95th quantiles. V CDF sup-distance must be <=0.15 as an auxiliary equivalence criterion; provide block/seed uncertainty intervals and normalized quantile differences. Do not report an iid KS p-value.
statistics.reference_comparison: New GPUMD reference jobs are independent SCR release runs, one per seed/profile, identical explicit model.xyz/run.in/potential bytes; system_clock release RNG is not seeded by registered model seed and is never assumed stepwise paired. Candidate runs use DMGMD_ENSEMBLE_SEED=<registered seed>. The same seed pairs initial model only for P1-GPUMD; MPI-P1 bridge additionally requires same DMGMD binary, model, run, potential, timestep, seed, root-owned RNG initialization/draw call order and shared Gaussian stream, evidenced from locked source and records. If source/build audit cannot prove this, bridge conclusions are disabled and no PASS may be inferred by this protocol.
statistics.same_condition_gate: Only one final look per registered condition. P1-vs-GPUMD direct primary and MPI-vs-P1 paired bridge combined by registered equations; all final combined mean and variance-ratio CIs must be wholly inside original bounds. Volume empirical CDF triangle sum must be <=0.15. A precise interval disjoint from bounds is FAIL; otherwise insufficient precision is INCONCLUSIVE. No new data may be pooled with original matrix.
statistics.confidence: Each primary/bridge component uses z=2.64 (two-sided nominal alpha=0.0082906027). Endpoint composition uses Bonferroni; nominal composite coverage is at least 1-2*alpha=0.9834188 only if the component Student-t/bootstrap intervals attain their nominal coverage. The intervals are approximate; this is not a finite-sample unconditional guarantee and not a joint guarantee over the full matrix.
statistics.no_posthoc_changes: Seeds, sample budgets, look count, input hashes, z, thresholds, bootstrap, block sizes, bridge equations and bridge eligibility are frozen before sampling. Preserve failures/inconclusive. Do not alter or pool the original preregistered study.

formula_fixture.gaussian_source: Fixed registered scalar(s), injected directly into pure host formula fixture; never use GPUMD release RNG or production RNG for this test.
assertions: zero-noise branch when B_GPa>2000 per compatibility rule

independent_physics.EOS_control_parameter: 425 GPa is only the input barostat control modulus.
independent_physics.separate_response_evidence: Measure a static pressure-volume EOS slope on the same NEP potential/diamond around the chosen state; report fitted range, slope, uncertainty and input hashes independently of control B.
independent_physics.independent_NPT_oracle: If candidate and GPUMD agree but disagree with independently verified target theory, preserve both results and classify theory check INCONCLUSIVE; use LAMMPS or a solvable independent sampler only if needed to diagnose a reproducible discrepancy.

confidence_composition.coverage_claim: Nominal per metric/profile/bridge comparison, conditional on the component Student-t/bootstrap intervals attaining their nominal coverage. Bonferroni union bound does not require component independence. The component intervals are approximate; no unconditional finite-sample coverage guarantee or full-matrix joint 95% claim.
confidence_composition.mean: combined point estimate = primary P1−GPUMD + bridge MPI−P1; combined CI = [Lprimary+Lbridge, Uprimary+Ubridge].
confidence_composition.variance_ratio: combined point estimate = (Var(P1)/Var(GPUMD))*(Var(MPI)/Var(P1)); combined CI = [Lprimary*Lbridge,Uprimary*Ubridge] for positive component ratio intervals. Each marginal component interval uses the same global unbiased variance estimator and frozen hierarchical seed/block bootstrap estimator; bridge resamples seed clusters then matched within-seed time-block indices.
confidence_composition.cdf: Use exact empirical ECDF triangle bound D(MPI8,P1_same8)+D(P1_same8,P1_full32)+D(P1_full32,GPUMD_full32) <= 0.15. P1_same8 is literally the corresponding subset of P1_full32; do not omit the subset-to-full empirical term. This is a deterministic bound on these pooled empirical ECDFs, not a population-sup confidence interval.

unchanged_final_bounds.cdf_triangle_interpretation: If the empirical triangle sum is <=0.15, the registered finite-sample upper bound passes. If it exceeds 0.15, this bound has not established the criterion: classify INCONCLUSIVE, not FAIL; do not infer the direct empirical MPI-vs-GPUMD distance exceeds 0.15.

precision_gates.tail_policy: Every burn-trimmed series length must be an exact multiple of block length; reject unregistered remainder.

pilot_power_simulation.method: Reproducible script reads and SHA-checks only the original eight-seed pilot thermo records, uses the registered thermo column mapping, centers the eight seed-level full-series differences at true zero, resamples 32 clusters 50,000 times using fixed seed, and takes the larger of the df=31 seed t half-width and projected block t half-width. Variance log-width uses the old analyzer percentile CI at z=2.394, scales it by 2.64/2.394 for the new component confidence, then divides by sqrt(8) exposure. This is a precision projection, not a bootstrap coverage or PASS guarantee; CDF power is not simulated.

base.interpretation: 50,000 replicates from the frozen pilot-only script; conditional on true mean difference zero and pilot-like dispersion.

half.interpretation: 50,000 replicates from the frozen pilot-only script; conditional on true mean difference zero and pilot-like dispersion.

power_estimates_at_true_zero.limitation: Only eight old pilot seed clusters inform dispersion; approximate conditional design power under a true-zero equivalence scenario, not a prediction or guarantee for observed nonzero effects. It does not simulate the CDF triangle criterion.
